body: S170-121: added the first hero respawn system to the arena MOBA -- death was permanent before this. Respawn is withheld until the hero's team owns at least one capture node, matching founder direction literally ('controlling a node enables its spawn for your team'). S170-122: frame-to-frame HP-decrease detection triggers a brief flash animation on hit heroes, reusing the existing placement-ring rendering. Also corrected a leftover S170-121 ID collision on the uncommitted Paimon hero work (renumbered to its real S170-55). Verified via full headless suite (259/259) + live systemd restart. Commit 3b63e43.
title: Node-gated hero respawn + basic auto-attack animations
